title: Play Script
description: Shape of the generated files in public/scripts/*.json. These are produced from the source markdown by parse_regexp.js and must not be hand-edited.

playTitle.description: The title of the play. Emitted for forward compatibility but never populated by the parser; always an empty string.

author.description: The author of the play. Never populated by the parser; always an empty string.

description.description: A brief description of the play. Never populated by the parser; always an empty string.

acts.description: List of acts in the play

actNumber.description: 1-based index of the act within the play

scenes.description: List of scenes in the act

sceneNumber.description: 1-based index of the scene, counted across the whole play rather than restarting each act

setting.description: Scene-level stage directions, gathered from the text before the first line of dialogue. Null when the scene opens directly with dialogue.

items.description: Either a spoken line or a standalone stage direction

actor.description: Name of the character delivering the line

setting.description: Stage direction attached to this line. Absent on continuation lines, null when the line carries no direction.
A stage direction occupying a line of its own, not attributed to any character
